name: atishbits-claude-skills
description: Skills from this repo that work on any surface, installable as plugins

plugins.name: news-briefing
plugins.description: A personal news briefing: global news, home-country news, news touching what you hold, and news on your interests, since the briefing last ran

plugins.name: portfolio-review
plugins.description: Review a long-term Indian equity portfolio: fundamentals, signal rows, BUY / HOLD / SELL notes. Keeps its memory in your cloud file storage, so it needs a file-storage connector.

plugins.name: pdf-unlock
plugins.description: Remove the open password from a password-protected PDF, given the correct password. Needs Python with pypdf[crypto], which it installs if missing, or the qpdf command.

plugins.name: itr2-filing-assistant
plugins.description: Prepare an Indian ITR-2 return end to end: document intake, reconciliation, schedule-by-schedule computation, regime comparison and a pre-submission check. It keeps its working files in a local folder, with an optional copy in your cloud storage that syncs when you ask.

plugins.name: advance-tax
plugins.description: Compute the Indian advance tax instalment due on a given date from FD interest, savings, dividends, house rent and bond interest. It keeps your rates and payment ledger in a local folder, with an optional copy in your cloud storage that syncs when you ask.

plugins.name: bond-portfolio-monitor
plugins.description: Monitor a bond portfolio held on an online bond platform: holdings, cash flows, repayment checks, and ENTER / SKIP and HOLD / REVIEW / EXIT verdicts with sources. Fetches fresh data through a browser when one is available and keeps a copy in your cloud storage, so it also runs without one from the newest copy.

plugins.name: mutual-fund-review
plugins.description: Review mutual-fund holdings across platforms and statements: returns against the right index and an after-tax FD, costs, and the tax in each fund. Fetches fresh data through a browser or a statement when asked, and otherwise works from the newest copy in your cloud storage.
